plan.understanding: Increase the single hollow cylindrical plant-pot holder to four uniformly spaced holders along the long rail, then add two continuous side ribs to widen and stabilize the resulting four-pot support.

subtasks.goal: On the sole solid, increase the hollow cylindrical holder assembly from one to four total instances by duplicating the existing concentric assembly comprising the BLUE outer r=7 mm cylinder (face #10, axis [0,1,0], center [0,29,4]), the RED r=5 mm bore (face #3, axis [0,1,0], center [0,29.5,4]), its opening faces #4 and #11, and the adjoining BSPLINE base face #9. Keep the original at x=0 mm and place copies at centers x=24, 48, and 72 mm, all at z=4 mm and with the same Y extents, producing four holders at uniform 24 mm pitch. Preserve each d=10 mm bore and d=14 mm exterior and unite every copy with the same body. Print the achieved holder-axis coordinates and correct them within the same attempt if they are not approximately [(0,*,4),(24,*,4),(48,*,4),(72,*,4)] mm. The new sites are empty; their nearest existing same-family holder is the source at x=0, respectively 24, 48, and 72 mm away.

On the same sole solid, add two continuous longitudinal stabilizing ribs on the opposite world-Z sides identified by planar faces #1 (normal [0,0,-1], z=2 mm) and #6 (normal [0,0,1], z=6 mm). Span each rib from x=-7 mm to x=80 mm so the pair supports the complete four-holder array. Give each rib a triangular Y-Z section running from the lower support level y=11 mm to y=15 mm: the -Z rib attaches at z=2 mm and widens to z=-3 mm at y=11 mm, while the +Z rib attaches at z=6 mm and widens to z=11 mm at y=11 mm. Unite both ribs with the rail, and print their achieved x, y, and z extrema, correcting them within the same attempt if they differ from x[-7,80], y[11,15], and the respective z[−3,2] and z[6,11] mm ranges.
